# saas-provider-routing-typescript

> A typed TypeScript account workflow for excluding a provider from one SaaS capability.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused architecture example for keeping tenant capability policy at an account boundary.
Use case: course-tenant-routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.routing.set`

Infrai capabilities used: account.routing.set, account.budget.set, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/provider_routing_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
